description: Wait for a live event and get it, or time out: “tell me when Steve logs in”, “wait for the console to say Done”. Types are WebSocket topics: player.join, player.leave, player.death, player.advancement, player.chat (chat:read), player.command and server.console (logs:read), player.respawn, player.level_up, player.sleep, player.world_change, player.kill, player.craft, block.break, block.place, world.weather, world.night_skipped, entity.boss_killed, raid.start, raid.finish, server.status, and more.

timeoutSeconds.description: Then answers timedOut. Clients built on the MCP SDK give up at 60

name: wait_for_event
title: Wait for something to happen
